item.title: [7] Superconducting diode effect in magnetic superconductors realized by nonreciprocal domain-wall dynamics
item.description:
Last authors: Suk Bum Chung, Se Kwon Kim

Authors: Dong Hui Han, Suk Bum Chung, Se Kwon Kim

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Interesting intersection of magnetic and superconducting order with topological implications.

Tags: #superconductivity #magnetism #transport

Abstract: The authors propose here a route to the superconducting diode effect through nonreciprocal magnetic domain-wall dynamics in ferromagnetic superconductors. Applied magnetic fields break time-reversal and inversion symmetries, producing direction-dependent critical currents for Walker breakdown—the onset of sustained domain-wall precession. Owing to the order parameter redundancy, the precession generates nonsingular phase slips. By connecting magnetic dynamics with superconducting transport, the authors identify a mechanism for realizing the superconducting diode effect without the need for complex heterostructures.
